profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Versatile and results-driven Full Stack .NET Developer with extensive experience designing and building desktop and web applications using the Microsoft technology stack. Began with Microsoft Access and VBA, then progressed to WinForms development using C#/VB.NET and the .NET Framework. Proficient in modern web development with ASP.NET MVC and Blazor, leveraging Entity Framework with Code First Migrations and ADO.NET for optimized data access. Skilled in front-end technologies including jQuery, DataTables, AJAX, JSON, and Bootstrap.

Strong database background with SQL Server (T-SQL) and Oracle (PL/SQL). Experienced in Agile development environments using Azure DevOps (ADO), Git, and TFS for source control and CI/CD pipelines. Knowledgeable in SSO integrations, Azure services, and an advocate for secure coding practices. Recently led a successful initiative to achieve GLAPI (Greenlight API) certification and developed a .NET 6 Blazor application using repository pattern and test-driven development. Committed to continuous learning and adoption of the latest .NET technologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and maintain web applications using ASP.NET MVC and Blazor, implementing Entity Framework with Code First Migrations and ADO.NET for performance-critical operations.

Utilize modern web technologies such as jQuery, jQuery DataTables, AJAX, JSON, and Bootstrap to build responsive and dynamic UIs.

Built and deployed applications with .NET 6 using Blazor for the front end and a RESTful API backend following repository pattern and TDD principles.

Strong database experience with SQL Server (T-SQL), supporting complex business logic and performance optimization.

Implemented CI/CD processes using Azure DevOps Pipelines; familiar with Git, TFS, and Agile methodologies including Azure Boards (ADO).

Advocated for security best practices across the team and helped lead the initiative to achieve GLAPI (Greenlight API) certification.

Recently working with SSO integrations, Azure services, and gaining experience with Azure Synapse Analytics (ASA).

Actively exploring and building with newer .NET versions to stay up to date with the evolving Microsoft ecosystem.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET MVC · Entity Framework · HTML5 · ADO.NET · Bootstrap · jQuery UI · .NET Core · Tricentis qTest · Checkmarx · Security Advocate · jFrog · REST APIs · Entity Framework (EF) Core · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · ASP.NET Razor · jQuery Datatables · Blazor · jQuery · Postman API · C# · Test-Driven Development · SQL · Sonarqube · Greenlight API · Azure piplines

positions.title: Software Developer (Contract)
positions.description:
Collaborated within an Agile development team to enhance a responsive MVC .NET web application platform, providing critical support for multiple internal customers.

Implemented role-based security features and developed new modules to expand the functionality of an existing application.

Contributed to the platform's evolution, enabling its use as a foundation for new development initiatives across the organization.

Utilized Microsoft Visual Studio, C#, Entity Framework (Code First Migration), Bootstrap, jQuery DataTables, and various jQuery/Bootstrap plugins to ensure scalability, maintainability, and user responsiveness.

positions.title: Parallon Business Solutions — Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Enhanced and mapped functionality between an Access 2010 VBA application and SQL Server backend for conversion to an MVC web application.

Developed solutions using VBA, C#, JavaScript, AJAX, JSON, and HTML, ensuring smooth data integration and user experience during the migration.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to improve the application's architecture, focusing on scalability, security, and performance.

Worked closely with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver optimized code to meet evolving business needs.

Applied best practices for data access using SQL Server, contributing to efficient query design and enhanced system performance.

Contributed to the migration effort by writing both front-end and back-end code, improving user interface responsiveness and overall functionality.

Supported transition to modern web technologies, ensuring smooth integration of new features while maintaining legacy system stability.

positions.title: Software Release Engineer (Contractor)
positions.description:
I worked at iPay Business Solutions, Inc.
Maintained and administered Visual Studio Team Foundation Server (TFS) repositories to support software development processes.

Managed and supported all development and testing environments, ensuring stability, availability, and proper configuration for developers and QA teams.

Provided hands-on assistance and troubleshooting during production deployments to ensure smooth and timely releases.

positions.title: Software Technician - Tier 3. (Contractor)
positions.description:
I worked at Homecare Homebase.
Identified and analyzed application behavior that deviated from design specifications.

Maintained a knowledge base with documented issue resolutions to support ongoing problem-solving efforts.

Triaged and prioritized support cases routed to the Tier-3 team.

Conducted trend analysis and reporting to keep the team informed of recurring issues.

Reproduced and troubleshot application issues to determine root causes.

Resolved complex customer issues through targeted data corrections.

Collaborated effectively with internal teams and external customers to ensure timely issue resolution.

Acted as a technical buffer between customer-facing support and development teams to streamline issue escalation.

Took on additional responsibilities as assigned, demonstrating flexibility and initiative.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Facilitated the successful migration of applications for new occupants at the Gaseous Diffusion Plant, addressing configuration and code issues during the transition to new servers.

Initiated development of a new web application using VB.NET and ASP.NET MVC architecture.
Converted legacy VB.NET web templates to C# to improve maintainability and align with updated development standards.

Designed and implemented various automation solutions, including WinForms applications, MVC web tools, and Adobe Acrobat automation using JavaScript for document processing and workflow improvements.

positions.title: Application Developer (Contractor)
positions.description:
I worked at Wastren Advantage, Inc.
Led the successful migration of legacy applications from the former contractor’s infrastructure to Department of Energy (DOE) servers.

Conducted thorough testing of applications to ensure functionality and compliance with DOE standards.
Documented application behaviors, dependencies, and configurations to support maintainability and knowledge transfer.

Identified and resolved configuration issues to ensure seamless operation in the new environment.

positions.title: Senior Consultant (Contractor)
positions.description:
I was contracted for National Government Services as System Engineer in EDI Systems.
Developed and maintained internal applications using the .NET framework, including Windows Forms and ASP.NET applications written in C# and VB.NET.

Utilized front-end technologies such as HTML, DHTML, and JavaScript to enhance user interfaces.

Designed and executed SQL queries using ADO.NET for data access and manipulation.

Deployed and configured third-party EDI software solutions to support business operations.

Performed low-level Unix system maintenance and administration tasks to ensure platform stability.

Diagnosed, troubleshot, and resolved application and system issues in a timely manner.

Collaborated with Business Analysts to fulfill data requests, extracting datasets from Oracle databases and Unix-based systems.

Authored automation and utility scripts in Perl and KornShell (KSH) to streamline processes and improve operational efficiency.

positions.title: Application Analyst 1 Developer
positions.description:
Provided support and enhancements for C# Windows applications developed on the .NET Framework, utilizing third-party UI controls including Infragistics and DevExpress. These N-tier applications consumed web services and operated with a SQL Server backend.

Responsibilities included bug fixing, performance optimization, and feature enhancements across several internal applications.

Took over full development and support responsibility for "Energy Master", a legacy Microsoft Access/VBA-based application used for natural gas management, purchases, and transportation, within the first two weeks of employment. This application was data-driven with a SQL Server 2008 backend.

Provided support for a Saratoga CRM application built by CDC Software, along with multiple other .NET applications integrated with the CRM’s SQL Server database.

Led the data conversion process for integrating new acquisition data into the CRM system. This involved consolidating data from three legacy systems (SQL and Oracle-based), including Energy Master, and migrating them to new C# Windows applications.

Configured and maintained linked servers (including Oracle) in SQL Server 2005 and 2008 environments to enable cross-platform reporting and data access.

Managed migrations of applications and services through various environments including Development, Testing, Staging, and Production. These migrations encompassed user interfaces, web services, and SQL Server databases.

Designed and built ad hoc reports using dynamic SQL to meet evolving business needs.

Contributed to the development of conceptual data and service models, which led to the implementation of Windows Services. These services were pivotal in helping the company retain a major supplier during the 2008 financial liquidity crisis.

positions.title: Electronic Filing Coordinator/Analyst
positions.description:
Previous Positions:
Accounts Receivable (A/R) Account Analyst
Collection Analyst Assistant

EDI Development & Analysis
Designed and developed EDI file reader/extractor and file manager application in VB.Net using Visual Studio 2005 Express, capturing transactions from 837I, 837P, 277, and 835 ASC X12N files into a Microsoft Access database.

Created an MS Access VBA EDI application to retrieve and analyze extracted EDI data for troubleshooting, auditing, and confirmation reporting of EDI transactions.

Performed end-to-end EDI billing and remittance testing with Medicaid state intermediaries and 835 remittance processing within A/R systems.

Acted as primary point of contact for EDI billing/payment issues, collaborating with internal and external teams to resolve problems efficiently.

Gathered and analyzed system requirements, recommended solutions, and helped create technical EDI specifications.

Maintained EDI transmittal instructions, provider enrollment documentation, and reference materials.
Provided training, support, and communication related to EDI provider contracts, billing, payments, and enrollments

Application Design & Development
Designed and built several MS Access VBA applications for claims processing of CMS-1500 and UB04 electronic claims aging report automation for A/R spreadsheets and management reporting tools.

Developed Word and Excel macros to improve operational efficiency and business productivity.

Authored user manuals and documentation for all custom-built VB.Net and Access applications.

Coordinated with external partners and carriers to ensure timely and compliant electronic billing, in line with state and federal regulations.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
Prior Positions:  Human Resource Assistant, Controller Assistant, Accounts Receivable Specialist, Job Cost Specialist, Accounts Payable Specialist, and Payroll Specialist.
Processed and tracked Job Cost, Accounts Receivable, Sales and use Tax returns, Bank Reconciliations, IFTA Fuel Motor Tax returns, General Ledger account analysis, Cash account analysis, and supervised Payroll in a multiple company environment.  
Within the first year, cut 50% of time out of my job by developing a Human Resource Access database application. 
Trained and helped the Payroll Clerk at Anson Stamping Company (a sister company) to develop a similar Access application. 
Saved the company time and money at year-end by producing spreadsheets for Auditors.  
Developed several small Access database applications to help other employees be more productive.  
Trained co-workers on use of MAS90 and other software applications. 
Administered MAS90, Windows NT 4.0, Desktop, e-mail, and Access Databases.  
Saved the company approximately $30k in Information Technology expenses by taking on projects such as merging two Mas90 systems into one, and solving problems that Anson would pay an outsourced company to resolve.

positions.title: Full Charge Bookkeeper
positions.description:
Responsibilities and Accomplishments
		
Totally overhauled new Great Plains accounting system.  
Re-entered five months of accounting records in the system and brought all data up to date within a month.  Processed all accounting transactions.
Produced database of customer security monitoring contracts utilizing Excel. 
Forecasted re-occurring revenue which enabled Jeppo to obtain a bank loan.  
Saved the company money by preparing payroll tax returns and W-2 statements that were previously prepared by their accounting firm.
